speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. Can you describe the nature of the flank pain and whether you have noticed any changes in your urine, such as color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any burning sensation when you urinate, or have your urinary habits changed, such as increased frequency or urgency? Also, does the pain radiate towards your groin or lower abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any joint pain, swelling, or abdominal discomfort while on either antibiotic? I also need to know if you have noticed any blood in your urine or if you have high blood pressure.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rash with amoxicillin and current symptoms with cephalexin, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum Creatinine, and CBC.
